_doc: Shunt's Arc Packs (Project Redmond R3, gadgets/R3_OPERATORS.md §2; anti hard breach, and tricking works, Ulo's): his ability, slot 2 (Z). Put down on a floor (`use.placeS`; within `arc.snapM` of a reinforced wall's or a barricade's face it goes against its foot, its prongs in), a pack is live at once and electrifies what it stands by within `arc.reachM` (gadgets/arcs.ts): a reinforced wall section (all of it) or a barricade, and any deployable shield or barbed wire of his side's. Any device of the attackers' on a live surface is burnt out `arc.burnS` after it's first found there: placed while it's live, or there already when the pack went live, so a pack picked up (Interact held) and put back catches a charge put on meanwhile. One already set off (burning, drilling) isn't stopped. An attacker's knife on a live surface shocks him (`arc.shock`, pushed back at `arc.pushMps`); an attacker's drone by a pack is jammed for `arc.droneJamS`. Electronic: an EMP turns it off for its seconds. One bullet destroys it. Its numbers are ours.
name: Arc Pack
